card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit before the decimal point in a section number such as 2.2 or 5.3, in label cross-references and headings. It also fires on a leading digit before a decimal in a dose.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a numbered section reference in parentheses or a heading, such as 5.3 or 2.2.

modes.label: Heading numbers
modes.description: The leading digit of a numbered subsection heading that starts a new section.

card.writes: It promotes quote marks and contractions, so it adds little that relates to section numbers.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a section number like 5.2 in drug label cross-references and headings.
